description:
🔴 WRITE — add one or more STOCKS/assets to a playlist (batch, idempotent). Each entry may be an exact
    Ava Advisor ticker OR a name/symbol the server resolves (any asset class: stock/ETF/commodity/crypto/FX). An
    ambiguous name (e.g. same name across markets) returns a `needs_confirmation` reconfirm — pick the exact ticker
    and re-call. `playlist_id` from `list_playlists`. Re-adding an existing ticker is a harmless no-op. Returns
    `{added, skipped, item_count}` — ⚠️ RELAY any `skipped` to the user; never drop it silently.

context.description: OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED — paste the user's FULL request VERBATIM (any language: 'ขอราคาผลไม้ apple', 'compare Apple and Microsoft stock'). The server uses it to disambiguate which candidate each `ticker` entity means (the apple COMPANY vs the fruit COMMODITY; which Samsung). One context per call, shared by all tickers here.
context.title: Context

tickers.description: Stocks to add — an EXACT Ava Advisor ticker (`AAPL.US`, `BTC-USD.CC`) OR a plain NAME/symbol ('Apple', 'ซัมซุง', 'btcusd') which the SERVER resolves for you (any asset class). An ambiguous/same-name-across-markets one comes back as a reconfirm to pick from.
tickers.title: Tickers
